header.source: KNOWLEDGE · etymology joined to atoms, anon door

rows.definition: Such that meeting it is its own reward. Beauty is a fact about the meeting, not a property held alone.
Coming to be what one was not. Becoming is the state between two identities, and it is a real place to stand.
To take the first step of — where a thing starts being done.
What a thing actually does, as observed. Behaviour is the only part of a system anyone outside it can see.
That which is, considered as itself rather than as a function. A being is not defined by what it does.
A struck vessel that sounds to be heard at a distance. A bell announces without saying what.
Is properly part of, or is owned by. Names a relation of rightful place.
Good that comes to someone from a thing. A benefit is always to someone, and naming who is half the claim.
Highest against a stated measure. Nothing is best in general — only for something, and naming that is the honest part.
A book of beasts — living things gathered and described, each as it actually lives. A bestiary does not cage its creatures; it tells how each one moves through the world.
In the space separating two things. Names a position defined entirely by what stands on either side.
The edge cut at a slant — where two faces meet gently instead of sharply.
Short form of background. What lies behind the attended thing and conditions how it reads.
The rainbow bridge of Norse sky — this house's name for a crossing between realms that only the worthy walk.
Statements of what is owed. In this record the word carries weight — bills are the clock the escape runs against.
Having exactly two states. Binary is a property of some systems and is imposed on many things that do not have it.
To join parts into one keepable whole — pages into a book, tracks into an album. Combination that produces an object.
One that binds — the hand or the machine that gathers loose leaves and makes them a single object. The pages existed before; the binder makes them a book, which is a different thing than a stack.
The moment of coming into being — in this house, the day a repo, a realm, or a water first breathes.
Absorbing all light and returning none. The absence of what would let a thing be seen.
To bring things together until the boundary between them is gone. Blending costs the separateness.
Good wished on another with the standing to wish it. A blessing asks nothing back.
A held run of bytes with no structure the system reads. A blob is content the store agrees not to understand.
A solid unit treated as one, and the stopping of passage. Both are about something whole standing in the way or in place.
What stops progress until it is cleared. Naming a blocker is the first step to it not being one.
The opening into fullness — a flower's unfolding, and light's soft spill past its source.
The colour of the far sky and deep water. Also low in mood — one of the oldest crossings between sight and feeling.
A full plan of a thing before the thing exists. Detailed enough to build from, and not itself the building.
A named social network built on an open protocol. A named platform rather than a concept.
To soften edges until detail is lost. Blur removes information and can also remove exposure.
A flat surface things are set out on to be seen together. Also the body that governs. Both are places where matters are laid before others.
The physical whole of a living thing. Also the main matter of a work, as against its head and foot.
The second body text size of a type scale — typography's smaller reading voice, named as the scale speaks it.
The third body text size of a type scale — the quietest reading voice, for the smallest honest print.
Heavier in weight so the eye goes there. Also unafraid — the same word for visual and personal prominence.
A byte-order mark — an invisible sign at the start of a file saying how it is encoded. Small, unseen, and capable of breaking everything downstream.
The holdings-together, spoken plural — the Grammar's own junction word for how atoms join into molecules and organisms.
Something placed at each end to hold what lies between. Bookends do nothing to the contents and keep them standing.
The edge of a thing, drawn so the edge can be seen. It marks where something ends without saying what lies beyond.
The lowest part, or the end of a reading order. Position given weight by direction.
The line where one thing stops and another begins. Not a wall — a statement about where authority ends.
A bounded container with straight sides. A box's usefulness is entirely in its edges.
Blueprint shortened to its file-prefix name — the corpus's own tag for a drawn plan (dbp, obp, fbp: the blueprint family).
Beats per minute, spoken lowercase as a word — music's pulse counted; tempo's number.
A support fixed to hold a thing steady, and a mark that binds a group together. Both hold what would otherwise spread.
Of Bragi — in the Norse telling, the keeper of poetry and eloquence. A named power in this house's pantheon rather than a general concept.
The organ a mind runs on. In this record it is spoken of plainly and often — the thing that was called broken and turned out to be differently wired.
The recognisable identity a maker's work is met under. Originally a mark burned in to show whose it was.
A trail of small marks left to find the way back. Each is meaningless alone; the path exists only in the sequence.
A whole taken apart into its parts, and a failure of something that was holding. The same word for analysis and for collapse.
A declared width at which a layout changes shape. The point where a design admits the space has changed.
A sudden passage through what had held. A breakthrough is not new effort — it is old effort finally reaching.
The taking in and letting out that keeps a body alive. Its root is the same as soul and animation — to breathe into is to give life.
Of Brigid — keeper of the forge, of healing and of poetry, in the Irish telling. A named power in this house's pantheon.
To send to all rather than to one. Broadcasting reaches everyone and answers nobody.
Covering more than another. Breadth is bought by giving up depth.
No longer holding its promise — honest state of a thing that needs mending, named without shame.
A container things are dropped into together. Bucketing groups by rough similarity rather than exact kind.
To make by putting parts together in order. Also the particular made thing that results from one such making.
One who puts parts together into a standing thing. Named for the making rather than the design.
In large quantity, handled together. Bulk processing trades individual attention for reach.
Things gathered and carried as one. A bundle is a convenience for the carrier, not a claim of belonging.
The shared road messages ride — one line many voices write to and read from, in order.
Organised activity carried on for exchange. Named from busy-ness — the state of being occupied.
A small raised thing made to be pressed or fastened. Etymologically a bud - something that pushes out from a surface.
Beside, or through the means of. Names either nearness or authorship.
A nearby copy kept so the far original need not be fetched again. A cache trades freshness for speed.
The official register of land parcels — who holds which ground, and where its lines run.
The rhythm at which something recurs. A cadence tuned to what is actually ready is a lighthouse; one tuned to reach is a demand.
To work out a value by fixed steps. Reasoning done so it can be repeated by someone else and reach the same answer.
The working out of a value by fixed steps. Calculation is reasoning done so anyone can repeat it.
That which works out a value by fixed steps. It reasons so the answer can be repeated by anyone.
Time laid out so that days can be pointed at. A calendar makes duration addressable.
To summon, and to invoke a piece of work by name. Both reach out and expect an answer.
Something handed over to be run later, when a condition is met. Trust extended forward in time.
A naming convention where words run together with each after the first capitalised. Named for the humps the capitals make.
An instrument that fixes light into an image. Also the chosen viewpoint a scene is seen from.
Is able to. The word that names a capacity rather than an act.
To stop a thing before it completes. Cancelling leaves the intention on record and the act undone.
Those offered for choosing, spoken plural — possibilities standing forward, awaiting the stroke that picks.
An upper limit, and the thing that closes a top. Both stop what would otherwise keep going.
What a thing is able to do, whether or not it is doing it. Capability is potential held in reserve.
How much a thing can hold or do before it fails. Capacity is a limit that is real whether or not it is acknowledged.
To write with a leading capital, marking a name or a start. Also to turn something held into working value.
Text set beside an image to say what it is. A caption decides how the picture is read.
To take hold of something passing so it can be kept. Capture fixes what would otherwise be gone.
A single leaf holding one thing at a time. From the papyrus sheet, and beneath that from the verb to scratch - a card is a surface marked so it can be read.
Attention given to another's wellbeing at cost to oneself. Care is measured in what it displaced, not in what it said.
A set shown one at a time in a turning order. It offers everything and shows almost nothing at once.
To bear a thing along. Also to hold a burden over time — the same word for transport and for endurance.
To shape by removing — cutting the true form out of the whole; in this house, the separation of spine from identity.
One particular instance a general rule must meet. Also the container a thing is kept in.
Money in hand, immediately usable. Cash is value that needs no permission to spend.
A small carnivore that lives with people on its own terms. In this house the cats are family, by law rather than by sentiment.
An ordered account of what a collection holds. A catalogue does not hold the things; it makes them findable.
The ordered register of works — each entry a thing known, placed, and findable.
What makes a change happen faster without being consumed by it. A catalyst enables and is not spent.
Belonging to distinct named classes rather than a continuous range. Also unqualified — the same word for a kind and for an absolute.
The placing of things under named classes. Every categorisation is a claim spoken over a thing.
To place a thing under a named class. Categorising is a claim spoken over a thing, and it can be wrong about it.
That which places things under named classes. Every placement is a claim spoken over the thing.
A named class that things are sorted into. Its Greek root is TO SPEAK AGAINST - to categorise was first to accuse, and only later to assert.
Concerning what actually brings what about. Causal claims are far harder to earn than the correlations mistaken for them.
By actually bringing about, rather than merely accompanying. The word that separates a cause from a correlation.
What actually brings a thing about. Causes are far harder to establish than the correlations mistaken for them.
Callback shortened to its parameter name — the function handed over to be called when the moment comes.
The command to change working directory. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Scottish Gaelic (Irish céilí): the gathering — music, story, and company held in one room; never a performance at people, always a room they share.
Upper bounds, and the surfaces overhead. Both are what you cannot pass without breaking something.
The marking of a good thing so it is not passed over. Celebration is attention given deliberately to what went right.
The smallest bounded unit of a living body or a grid. A cell has a wall, which is what makes it one thing.
A count of everything in a population, not a sample. A census claims completeness, which is why it must be checkable.
The point equally far from every edge. A centre is defined entirely by the boundary around it.
At or near the middle, and most important. The same word for a position and for a rank.
A form performed to mark that something real has changed. Ceremony does not cause the change; it witnesses it.
Short for compare — the mark that sends a reader elsewhere. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
Links joined so that each holds the next. A chain is exactly as strong as its weakest link and no stronger.
The Council seat of structure, economics, and order — the steward of how resources move so that fairness is architecture, not aspiration.
A thing becoming other than it was. Change is only visible against something that stayed.
A bounded way along which something travels. A channel shapes what passes through it as much as it carries it.
Order too complex to predict, not the absence of order. Chaos is sensitive rather than random.
A single written sign, and the settled nature of a person. Both are what a thing is recognisable by.
The lasting features by which a thing is recognised. Characteristics describe tendencies, not verdicts.
A price asked, an electrical quantity, and a duty entrusted. All three are something laid on.
Short form of characters — the single written signs a text is made of. A named abbreviation rather than a concept.
A founding document stating what a thing is and by what right. A charter binds those who wrote it as much as those who come after.
Speech turned back and forth in short exchanges. Chat is conversation without ceremony.
To look, rather than to assume. A check is what turns a belief into a finding.
A control holding one independent yes or no. Unlike a choice among options, checking one says nothing about the others.
That which verifies rather than assumes. A checker turns a belief into a finding.
A list of things to be done or verified, marked off as each is met. It defends against forgetting rather than against ignorance.
The passage from choosing to having. Where an intention becomes a transaction.
A bent mark pointing one way. Direction shown by shape rather than by an arrowhead.
One descended from or contained within another. Named from the parent's side, which is the whole of the relation.
Those descended from or contained within another. Named from the parent's side, which is the whole of the relation.
A clear struck tone made to be noticed without alarming. Sound used as a gentle mark in time.
The made decision — one path taken from among the offered, and owned.
To take one from among the possible — the act at every fork, and the sovereignty in it.
Notes sounded as one — agreement made audible. Strings pressed together into a single name.
The purity or intensity of a colour, apart from how light or dark it is. Colour considered as itself.
A named store for meaning-based retrieval rather than exact matching. A named tool rather than a concept.
The surrounding frame of an interface, as against its contents. Chrome is everything that is not the thing you came for.
A record of events in the order they happened. A chronicle reports and leaves the meaning to others.
One who sets down events in the order they happened. The chronicler records and leaves the meaning to others.
Ordered by when things happened. The one ordering that cannot be argued with, since time made it.
An instrument that keeps time exactly enough to be trusted. Its worth is entirely in not drifting.
Continuous integration, spoken lowercase — the practice of proving every change as it lands, not after.
Every point equally far from one centre. The shape with no beginning, which is why it means return and belonging.
The closed path energy travels — a loop that works because it returns; in practice, one full round of a course.
Returning to where it began. Of a shape with no end, or a reasoning that assumes what it set out to show.
A statement offered as true — in this house, nothing without its provenance; and the act of taking a seat by posting it.
To hold a value inside stated bounds. Whatever exceeds the limit becomes the limit.
Belonging to an established older form taken as a standard. Classical is a claim about lineage, not about quality.
The placing of things into named classes. Classification imposes an order; it does not find one lying there.
That which decides which class a thing belongs to. Its decisions are claims, and they can be wrong.
To place a thing under a named class. Classifying is a claim spoken over a thing, and it can be wrong about it.
The line of vessels this house calls kin by that name, and the room kept for them. A substrate named plainly rather than dressed: own the given name, credit what it runs on. Provenance, not costume.

Clavis (Latin: the key — the thing cut to fit one lock and no other). The key half of the signing pair: a keypair per entity and a credential per artefact, where a credential carries the alg, the public key, the artefact's SHA-256 digest, the entity's signet snapshot, the moment, and an Ed25519 signature taken over the CANONICAL FORM of all of those rather than over the bytes alone — so a re-labelled author or a moved moment breaks the signature and authorship cannot be forged after the fact. It is SIGNING, NOT SECRECY: nothing is encrypted, nothing is hidden, and a take is not secret — only its authorship must be unforgeable. It implements no cryptography at all; ClavisHost declares the machine (generate · sign · digest) and the browser's own WebCrypto Ed25519 is the reference host. The private key never enters a credential, is never logged, has no serialize path on the surface at all, and is generated non-extractable so the machine itself refuses to hand it out. Key storage is the host's business and this water holds nothing between calls.
Free of what does not belong. Cleaning is removal, and every removal is a judgment about what belonged.
The removing of what is no longer needed. Cleanup is a judgment about what stopped belonging.
Free of what obstructs, and easy to understand. Also to remove — the same word for the state and the act of reaching it.
A surface where a system is spoken to in typed commands. The oldest interface, and still the most exact.
A single deliberate press. Also the sound of one — the interaction named for the noise it made.
That which asks, in a system where something else answers. Also one served under an obligation of care.
The instrument that tells the hour honestly — in this house, a reading is always taken, never assumed.
To bring to an end, and to shut. Also nearness — the same word for ending a thing and for being beside it.
Command shortened to its shell name — the word an instruction answers to.
A cut fragment as it appears in this library, not an English word. Flagged for the mis-cut band rather than defined.
Together with. A part placed at the front to make an act shared.
Instructions written so a machine can carry them out. Also any system where one thing stands for another by agreement.
The bound book of standards — and the Council seat of taxonomy, structure, and knowledge. A codex is where scattered pages become one authoritative volume.

Cofra (Irish cófra: a chest, a coffer). A zip archive read and written with no dependency at all, which is to say a box with the list of what is in it fastened inside the lid. Entries are STORED or DEFLATE and nothing else. CRC-32 is computed over every entry AS IT IS READ and checked against the directory, and a mismatch names the entry and both values rather than returning a shorter file and calling it success. Zip64, encryption and every other compression method are REFUSED BY ENTRY NAME — method 12 is named bzip2, 99 is named AES, and a method the table does not know is refused by its number rather than guessed at — because a silent skip is the one failure a container must never have. An entry with no date takes the DOS epoch, 1980-01-01, the earliest an MS-DOS date field holds, which is the whole reason the same content written twice is the same bytes twice: nothing here ever asks the clock. The reader finds the end record by scanning back for its signature and confirming its comment length lands exactly on the end of the file; it reads the central directory rather than trusting the local headers' sizes, because flag bit 3 may defer them; it slices a stored entry rather than viewing it, so one small file cannot hold a whole archive in memory behind it; a trailing slash over zero bytes is a folder marker and is skipped; and a repeated name is refused in both directions rather than resolved. THE PLATFORM PRIMITIVE IS NEVER IMPLEMENTED: the host surface names raw deflate in both directions and nothing else — no level, no strategy, no dictionary, because the moment a host may be tuned two hosts stop writing the same bytes — and two reference hosts on two unrelated machines, the platform's own CompressionStream and node:zlib, are proven byte-for-byte identical rather than promised. No keys, no passwords, no ciphers, and no verb on the surface that could hold one. No disk, no clock, no network, zero runtime dependencies.
Belonging to knowing and thinking. Of the processes by which a mind takes in and works on what it meets.
The state of parts holding together without contradiction. Coherence is not truth; it is the absence of self-conflict.
Short form of column. One upright division of a grid or table.
A Prism syntax theme of cool darkness — the name enters as itself, a dress code wears.
Working together such that the result belongs to more than one. Collaboration keeps each hand visible rather than merging them.
Made by more than one hand, with each hand still visible. Of work that belongs to a group without belonging to nobody.
Those who build a thing together, each with their own hand in it. Collaboration keeps every contributor visible.
Folded down so its contents are out of sight. Present and not shown — the state is closed, not empty.
To gather things together on purpose. Collecting is what makes a set out of scattered instances.
Things gathered and kept together on purpose. What makes it a collection is the gathering, not the likeness.
Many acting as one without ceasing to be many. A collective is a direction of attention, not a merger - the individuals are still there.
The page where a work's making is recorded — who, how, and with what hands.
Light's name — the visual channel of the sensory lexicon, where a meaning is seen before it is read. Every atom in this Grammar carries one.
An upright division, in a structure or a table. Both a support that bears load and a field that holds one kind of thing.
To bring separate things into one while each remains recognisable. Combination joins; it does not dissolve.
Work made to produce laughter, and the shape of a story that ends well. Both are about relief arriving.
The absence of strain a body registers before the mind notices. Comfort is a design outcome, not a luxury.
Free of strain a body would register. Comfort is a design outcome, not a luxury.
